name: dsh-plugin-dsh-continue
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: auto-resume interrupted agent runs. When a session's turn ends in a transport/connection error or is crash-orphaned (or a tool call is interrupted with no recorded result), the plugin re-sends the configured prompt (default "继续") to the same live session — with per-session attempt cap, cooldown, and exponential backoff — so a flapping transport no longer forces you to type 继续 by hand. Idempotency stays the agent's own responsibility; this plugin only owns the structural guardrails.
